reader_notes: Reads like a genuine byggnadshistorisk essay: the causal chain (which clay grave, frost weathering, the kollergång, position in the kiln chamber, and finally kalkspräckning) held together on a single pass, and every question was answerable from the text.
Small arithmetic wobble: the works ran from 1868 and the stamp disappeared in 1897, which the opening calls 'brukets första trettio år' — 29 years. Reads as ordinary rounding, but I noticed it.
The hedge 'tycks ha' appears in q1 option D and q4 option D, and in both cases the hedged option is the one I discarded. A test-wise reader could start treating that phrasing as a wrongness tell.

Nice framing: the flisor described in the magasin wall in the opening are explained only in the second half, and the closing paragraph (damaged faces normally turned inward, turned outward here) pays the image off.
Names (Evald Vrenmark, Boel Rundhage) feel a shade constructed, but nothing a reader would stop on.
